title: The target-open rho and coefficient-unit locality square
statement: Fix the finite purity setting P with coefficient ring A [def-pur-conventions]. Let f:X→Y and g:Z→Y be separated quasi-compact locally finite-type maps, and X,Z,Y Noetherian. Let aY:Y→Spec(k) be quasi-compact and locally of finite type, V an affine open in Y, N a normalized compact-support datum [def-sp-etale-compact-support-normalization], and U a Noetherian scheme. Let j:U→X and v:U→Z be separated etale maps with v≫g=j≫f. Let O⊆U be open with maps jO:O→f⁻¹V and vO:O→g⁻¹V satisfying jO≫(f⁻¹V).ι=O.ι≫j and vO≫(g⁻¹V).ι=O.ι≫v. Write fV=f|V, gV=g|V, nu for the ordinary/pro-etale comparison, and h=jO≫fV=vO≫gV. Assume further that f,g are smooth of common pure relative dimension d≥0 and compactifiable, that j,v are quasi-compact and locally of finite type, that j≫f and v≫g are compactifiable, and choose affine diagonal geometries H,K [lem-pur-affine-target-diagonal-dnc]. Let L be restrictedDualizingTransport [def-pur-diagonal-etale-restricted-dualizing-transport]. Set rf=rho_f inverse followed by (f⁻¹V).ι*nu_X*(unitChange_f), and define rg similarly, using [def-pur-diagonal-orientation-refinement-data, def-pur-diagonal-counit-comparison-data]. Let cj,cv be the actual restrictionAlong comparisons, T=O.ι*, and B=diagonalEtaleLocality(N,v,g) followed by diagonalDualizingCongr(v≫g=j≫f) followed by inverse diagonalEtaleLocality(N,j,f) [def-pur-diagonal-dualizing-data]. Then L.hom followed by vO*(rg.hom) equals jO*(rf.hom) followed by cj.hom, inverse T*nu_U*B, and cv.inv. No source invariant, sourceTransport or alpha occurs.

proof.text: Identify the normalized tensor-mate locality on the unit with the counit-normalized structural locality using locality_tensorMate and locality_tensorMate_congr. Recover its composition law by inverting source_comp_eq after sourceEtale_locality_congr. These are existing proved identities, not new obligations.

For each etale source map, form its full inverse image of V and apply structural_locality_baseChange to the two Cartesian squares. For arbitrary O, use the canonical lift from O into that full inverse image. Its composite with the open immersion is O.ι, so the lift is an open immersion. Restrict the Cartesian identity along this lift and apply locality composition. Associativity of inverse-image composition identifies the resulting source square with its actual arrows hj or hv.

Use pullComparison_comp and pullComparison_naturality to pass the structural identity through the ordinary/pro-etale comparison. The pullback-composition identity is exactly restrictionAlong, and the target-open comparison is the defining pullComparison followed by the dualizing base-change isomorphism in rho. Naturality of the tensor-mate transformation on the monoidal-unit/degree-zero coefficient isomorphism inserts unitChange on both sides.

Apply the resulting square to j and v using their common composite j≫f=v≫g and common restricted map q=jO≫fV=vO≫gV. Their two maps to the common restricted dualizing object factor restrictedDualizingTransport. Cancel the common restriction map and coefficient-unit change. The remaining locality factors combine to inverse B and yield the claimed equation.

theorem diagonalEtaleRhoUnitSquare (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification g]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (H : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry f aY d V)
    (K : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry g aY d V)
    (N : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient)
    (U : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian U]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] [IsSeparated j] [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (v : U ⟶ Z) [Etale v] [IsSeparated v] [LocallyOfFiniteType v] [QuasiCompact v]
    (w : v ≫ g = j ≫ f)
    [HasCompactification (j ≫ f)] [HasCompactification (v ≫ g)]
    (O : U.Opens) (jO : O.toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (vO : O.toScheme ⟶ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (hj : jO ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ j)
    (hv : vO ≫ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ v) :
    let νX := (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) X).mapDerivedCategory
    let νZ := (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) Z).mapDerivedCategory
    let νU := (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) U).mapDerivedCategory
    let T := OrientationRefinement.pull P O.ι
    let cj := OrientationCounit.restrictionAlong P j (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) O jO hj
    let cv := OrientationCounit.restrictionAlong P v (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) O vO hv
    let B := (P.diagonalEtaleLocality N v g) ≪≫
      (P.diagonalDualizingCongr w) ≪≫ (P.diagonalEtaleLocality N j f).symm
    let rf := (OrientationRefinement.rho P f aY d V H).symm ≪≫
      (OrientationRefinement.pull P (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).mapIso
        (νX.mapIso (OrientationCounit.unitChange P f))
    let rg := (OrientationRefinement.rho P g aY d V K).symm ≪≫
      (OrientationRefinement.pull P (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).mapIso
        (νZ.mapIso (OrientationCounit.unitChange P g))
    let L := DiagonalEtaleComparison.restrictedDualizingTransport P f g aY V N U j v w
      O jO vO hj hv
    L.hom ≫ (OrientationRefinement.pull P vO).map rg.hom =
      (OrientationRefinement.pull P jO).map rf.hom ≫
        (cj.app (P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing f)).hom ≫
        (T.mapIso (νU.mapIso B)).inv ≫
        (cv.app (P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing g)).inv
